Title: Azure SQL DB—More storage for Premium elastic pools

Body.Content:
Storage limits for the largest Premium elastic pools in Azure SQL Database will soon increase from 750-gigabytes (GB) to as much as 4-terabytes (TB). This extra storage will be available in a limited number of regions with more widespread availability planned for the near future.

To learn more, visit the Azure Blog.
